PFM Accounts v2 — Design vs Dev

This document identifies every formatting difference between the approved Pencil designs and the current dev implementation on app.eg-dev.ai. Use it as a checklist to bring dev into pixel-perfect alignment with design.

228 gaps to fix
80 already match
335 total items

How to read each section

  • Design panel (left) — the approved Pencil frame, cropped to the relevant area
  • Dev panel (right) — screenshot from app.eg-dev.ai at the same area
  • Comparison table — row-by-row differences with status: Gap = needs fixing, Match = already correct
  • Required change column — exactly what dev needs to do to match design

Key rules

  • Design wins. Where design and dev differ, dev must change to match design.
  • Hemlock tokens. Both use tokens from hemlock-library.lib.pen. A "Match" means the same token is used. A "Gap" means a different token or hardcoded value.
  • Buttons = Hemlock refs. Every button must be a Hemlock library component ref — override label, icon, text color, or letter-spacing only.
  • Color context matters. The accounts list uses color-gray-500 for meta text. The detail modal uses colors-text-meta. They are different tokens — don't conflate them.
  • Round to nearest dollar. Net Worth and row balances show whole dollars only (no cents).

Sources

  • Design: pfm-accounts-v2.pen (desktop + mobile frames)
  • Dev: app.eg-dev.ai/net-worth/accounts on develop branch
  • Tokens: hemlock-library.lib.pen
